meta.name: icp-definer
meta.description: Define and prioritize narrow Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) for outbound targeting. Use when asked "who should we target", "define ICP", "best customers for X", "outbound targeting", "who gets most value", "segment customers", "narrow audience", "prioritize accounts", "who should we reach out to", or "build me an outbound ICP". Always use this skill before building any list or writing any outreach.

copy.tagline: 定义并优先排序理想客户画像，用于精准外呼
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要明确谁是最值得主动触达的客户
copy.tagline_en: Define and prioritize ideal customer profiles for outbound targeting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify who to reach out to first

howto.what: Claude 会引导你定义窄化的理想客户画像（ICP），先收集产品、现有客户、定价等输入，再生成 3-5 个 ICP 假设，按疼痛程度、预算、可触达性、时机评分排名，最后为前两名生成含企业、技术、触发事件、买家画像等详细信息的卡片。
howto.when: 当你询问“该瞄准谁”、“定义 ICP”、“最佳客户”等类似关键词，或要求构建外呼列表、写外呼文案时触发。

say.note: Claude 开始收集产品、客户等信息。

say.text: 帮我定义一下理想客户画像
say.note: Claude 生成 ICP 假设并评分。

say.text: 谁是最可能购买的客户？
say.note: Claude 输出前两名 ICP 卡片。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to define narrow Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) by collecting inputs (product, existing customers, pricing), generating 3-5 ICP hypotheses, scoring them on pain, budget, reachability, and timing, then creating detailed cards for the top 2.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'who should we target', 'define ICP', 'best customers for X', or similar phrases, or when you ask to build an outbound list or write outreach.

say_en.text: Define ideal customer profile for me
Who is most likely to buy?
